title: leucanthemum vulgare subsp. crassifolium
intro: Leucanthemum vulgare subsp. crassifolium, commonly known as a type of dandelion, is a perennial plant species that belongs to the Asteraceae family. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering potential health benefits such as supporting liver function and acting as a natural diuretic, helping to alleviate symptoms of urinary issues and fluid retention. The therapeutic actions of Leucanthemum vulgare subsp. crassifolium include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may contribute to its potential in reducing inflammation and protecting against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
